topic: What feed element spacing balance minimizes dB loss while maintaining beamforming flexibility in defocused systems?
consensus_response: Optimal feed element spacing balances dB loss and beamforming flexibility by managing mutual coupling, grating lobes, and digital compensation. Non-uniform geometries reduce interference, while machine learning algorithms optimize weight calculations, simplifying signal processing and calibration.
reference_context: SatCom systems optimize performance with digital beamforming, array calibration, and non-uniform geometries to minimize dB loss and enhance flexibility.
